name: Tunenoodle
tagline: AI music generator with free browser audio tools
description: Tunenoodle is an AI music generator that turns a text idea, lyrics, a hummed melody or an image into a song. It also offers extend, replace section, mashup, stem splitter, text to speech and a Music Agent. Alongside the AI features, Tunenoodle provides free browser-based tools that need no account, including audio to MIDI, a MIDI editor, tap tempo, chord progression generator, audio chord analyzer, sheet music scanner, speed and pitch changer, slowed + reverb, and spectrum analyzer. The interface is available in 10 languages. AI features use credits; the browser tools are free.
